# Decision-first AI text kit

By [Ahmadreza Samadi](https://a-samadi.com/about.html).

An editable text companion to my [decision-first AI guide](https://a-samadi.com/tools/before-you-build-ai.html). Use it to record the decision, evidence, acceptance criterion and review rules before trying an AI workflow.

## Start with a blank copy

[Download the four-file ZIP](Decision-First-AI-Text-Kit.zip), extract it and open [Decision-First-AI-Blank.txt](Decision-First-AI-Blank.txt) in a text editor. Save a private working copy and fill the ten fields. No installation or account is needed to edit the text; your editor and storage settings determine where saved notes go.

The separate [fictional example](Decision-First-AI-Fictional-Example.txt) illustrates the same card. Read its [interpretation notes](Reading-Notes.txt) and [start instructions](Start-Here.txt). Do not carry invented answers into actual experiment records.

This is a proposed planning aid, not a validated assessment. No experiment was run and no company or customer result is represented. Unknown outcomes remain unknown. Prepared with AI assistance; the existing PDF and interactive guide remain unchanged. No new blanket reuse licence is asserted.
